entry_state: Financing feasibility follows settlement order, net proceeds, eligibility and remaining obligations. Conversion can change the person selecting policy, so a competitive price must use that controller's continuation. Correct pricing and positive owner value still leave funding-prefix and accounting-measurement questions.
exit_state: Funding and control do not determine accounting classification or yields; issuer and holder may require different treatments and dated authority. Equity financing must separately track liquidity, share count, transferred value and security-specific payoff rights. A balanced cash/equity journal cannot reveal dilution or a double-counted conversion payoff.
